_note: INPUT of the draw (hand-edited, reviewed). Parameters of the FIXED 45-item anchor set (supervisor, 2026-08-27; item A4 of docs/plan/2026-09-14-post-supervisor-meeting-phase.md): 15 items per hop count, drawn once at random from the ADR 0007 pinned 600 and then inspected by hand in every experiment. Two files, two roles, and the filenames say which: THIS file (anchor_set_draw.json) holds the parameters and is the only one a human edits; configs/anchor_set_ids.json is the GENERATED, frozen output of running those parameters and is never hand-edited - re-running scripts/build_anchor_set.py --write over it needs --force, and changing any value here invalidates the committed list (--verify will say so). Conventions recorded in ADR 0032.

questions_jsonl._note: The pinned ADR 0007 files are JSONL with one id field; the decomposer reads them through the same key name (configs/decomposer_musique.json questions_jsonl.id_field), so the two cannot drift on what an id is.

ids_file_note: FROZEN. The 45 anchor ids of supervisor item A4, drawn once at seed 42 from the ADR 0007 pinned 600 and fixed over all experiments. Ids and provenance only - no question text, no gold decompositions, no predictions (CLAUDE.md: data never enters git). Regenerate only with scripts/build_anchor_set.py --write --force, which changes what every experiment's manual inspection is looking at; scripts/build_anchor_set.py --verify re-derives this file and fails if it differs.
